sents.t: On Christmas Eve, snow was falling softly, and Main Street was full of lights.
I had asked Lily to meet me at the gazebo in Maple Park at seven.
I had spent weeks planning this moment.
I wanted to do it in the park that the neighbors had saved in the summer, where we had taken our first walk together.
Carlos and Ana helped me hang lights in the branches of the old oak tree.
Emma came from Chicago and promised to hide behind a bush with a camera.
Rosa insisted on bringing hot chocolate.
When Lily arrived, she stopped walking.
My heart was beating so fast that I forgot my speech.
I had practiced saying it a hundred times, but now I couldn’t remember a single word.
So I decided to say what I felt.
“Lily, I came to this country to find a job. I didn’t expect to find you. I love waking up in the same town as you, and I want to keep doing it for the rest of my life.”
I knelt in the snow and opened the little box.
Lily started crying and laughing at the same time.
Then everyone, even Max, ran out, and we were all hugging in the snow.

comp.q: Where did Sam ask Lily to meet him?
o: at the gazebo in Maple Park
comp.fa: سام از لیلی خواست کجا او را ببیند؟

comp.q: Why did Sam choose Maple Park?
o: They had taken their first walk together there.
comp.fa: چرا سام پارک میپل را انتخاب کرد؟

comp.q: Who insisted on bringing hot chocolate?
comp.fa: چه کسی اصرار داشت شکلات داغ بیاورد؟

o: He read it from a paper.
He forgot it and said what he felt.
comp.fa: چه بر سر سخنرانی سام آمد؟

o: She cried, laughed, and said yes.
